title: Consistency with the Source of Life
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner shares the key to spiritual growth and fruitfulness in your life: consistency in the word and in prayer. By grounding yourself in Scripture and communicating with God through prayer, you'll experience the transformation and peace that comes from knowing and obeying God's will. Join Pastor Chris as he breaks down the importance of these two essential habits in living a life that produces long-lasting fruit.
